system.description: Attacks against the @Lookup[@name] are made with disadvantage unless the attacker spends a handful of gold. This @Lookup[@name] starts with a number of handfuls equal to the number of PCs. When a target marks HP from the @Lookup[@name]'s standard attack, they can spend a handful of gold instead of marking HP (1 handful per HP). Add a handful of gold to the @Lookup[@name] for each handful of gold spent by PCs on this feature.
